meta.title: multiexperience | Custom systems and websites for small and mid-sized businesses
meta.description: Custom software and website development for small and mid-sized businesses. Makers of MX Clinics. Santos, SP, Brazil.

hero.subtitle: We develop the software your business needs to operate, from mapping the process to delivery and maintenance. You follow and validate every step.

problems.label: Problems we solve
problems.title: When it makes sense to talk to us

items.title: Operations run on spreadsheets and WhatsApp
items.desc: Information is scattered across files and chats, with no history, and depends on who remembers it. A system keeps the data in one place, with access by role.

items.title: Off-the-shelf software doesn't fit your process
items.desc: Packaged software was designed for a generic process. When yours is different, the team ends up working around the tool. With custom software, the system follows the process.

items.title: Your tools don't talk to each other
items.desc: The same data is typed into more than one system, which creates rework and mismatches. Integrations and APIs make the systems exchange data on their own.

items.title: The website exists but brings no contacts
items.desc: Visitors can't find what the company does or a clear way to reach it, and Google can't see the content. Structure, copy, and technical foundations fix all three.

services.label: What we do
services.title: Our services

items.title: Custom systems

benefits: Technical foundations to show up on Google

services.extra: We also do process consulting: we map how the operation works before deciding what is worth turning into a system.

about.card1_intro: multiexperience started in 2020, while we were still in college, with the goal of delivering quality technology to the market. Today we are a team of developers in Santos, SP, Brazil. We build systems and websites for small and mid-sized businesses and maintain our own product, MX Clinics.

about.card2_intro: Every project goes through the same four steps.

card2_steps.label: Discovery
card2_steps.desc: A conversation to understand the process, the goal, and the constraints. You receive a written summary of the problem and of what will be built.

card2_steps.label: Proposal
card2_steps.desc: Scope, timeline, and price in writing, before any development starts.

card2_steps.label: Building in short cycles
card2_steps.desc: At the end of each cycle you see a working version and validate it before we move on. Progress is visible to you the whole time.

card2_steps.label: Delivery and continuity
card2_steps.desc: After launch, we continue with fixes and adjustments as agreed in the proposal.

items.a: It depends on the scope. After the discovery conversation you receive a proposal with a fixed price.
The timeline depends on the scope and comes in the proposal, together with the price.
